s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent episodes of neurological deficits with evidence of inflammation and white matter changes
salient_findings: Mild headache and right facial droop
key_facts: History of well-controlled hypertension and hyperlipidemia
On methotrexate and sulfasalazine treatment
Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein level
High titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody
CSF analysis showed 12/µL white blood cell count and 4 oligoclonal bands
MRI Brain showed extensive white matter changes with enhancement
No acute infarct in diffusion-weighted imaging sequence
Brain biopsy showed thick exudate in subarachnoid space with lymphocytes and plasma cells

raw.syndrome_frame: Recurrent episodes of neurological deficits with evidence of inflammation and white matter changes
salient_findings: Mild headache and right facial droop
key_facts: History of well-controlled hypertension and hyperlipidemia
On methotrexate and sulfasalazine treatment
Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein level
High titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody
CSF analysis showed 12/µL white blood cell count and 4 oligoclonal bands
MRI Brain showed extensive white matter changes with enhancement
No acute infarct in diffusion-weighted imaging sequence
Brain biopsy showed thick exudate in subarachnoid space with lymphocytes and plasma cells

raw.rationale: The presence of extensive white matter changes with enhancement along the arachnoid surface, elevated inflammatory markers, and brain biopsy findings of a thick exudate in the subarachnoid space with lymphocytes and plasma cells are consistent with neurosarcoidosis.

rejected.label: multiple sclerosis
rejected.why: While the patient has white matter changes and oligoclonal bands, the presence of systemic inflammation and specific biopsy findings are not typical for multiple sclerosis

rejected.label: autoimmune encephalitis
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and biopsy findings do not specifically suggest an autoimmune encephalitis, which typically involves more pronounced inflammation and antibody-mediated responses

rejected.label: hypertension
rejected.why: Hypertension is a comorbidity but does not explain the neurological symptoms or the specific findings on imaging and biopsy

rejected.label: ischemic stroke
rejected.why: The absence of an acute infarct on diffusion-weighted imaging and the presence of systemic and CSF inflammatory markers argue against ischemic stroke as the primary diagnosis
